objective: Add a node:test unit test for cleanFilename in lib/utils/clean-filename.js, covering extension stripping, separator-to-space conversion, first-token title-casing with the rest lowercased, and acronym preservation. Do not modify the function itself.
acceptance_criteria: A new file lib/utils/clean-filename.test.js exists and uses Node's built-in node:test runner (no vitest/jest).

Tests assert: a .md/.txt/.markdown extension is stripped; '-' and '_' become single spaces with runs collapsed; the first token is Title-cased and remaining tokens are lowercased; known acronyms such as LLM and API are preserved in uppercase.
Running 'node --test lib/utils/clean-filename.test.js' passes with all assertions.
